---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
a<- read_excel("data/g24-results-by-district.xlsx")
a_clean <- a |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~str_replace_all(.x, "\\r\\n", " "))) |>
  filter(!(is.na(`...2`) & is.na(`...3`))) |> 
  filter(!str_detect(`1st Congressional District`, "Congressional District")) |> 
  filter(!str_detect(`1st Congressional District`, "Percent|Totals")) |> 
  filter(!(`1st Congressional District` %in% c("DEM", "REP")))
clean_long <- a_clean |> 
  mutate(county = `1st Congressional District`,party = `...2`,votes = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`...3`))) |>
  filter(party %in% c("DEM", "REP")) |> 
  select(county, party, votes)
final_votes <- clean_long |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = party,values_from = votes)
print(final_votes)

```



```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)

VOTE_DATA_PATH <- "data/G24_SOV_by_g24_svprec.csv"
SR_SHAPEFILE_PATH <- "data/srprec_state_g24_v01_shp (3)" 
AB604_SHAPEFILE_PATH <- "data/AB604" 

VOTE_ID_NAME <- "SVPREC" 
DEM_VOTES_NAME <- "CNGDEM01"
REP_VOTES_NAME <- "CNGREP01"

vote_data <- read_csv(VOTE_DATA_PATH) %>%
  rename(SR_Precinct_ID = VOTE_ID_NAME, 
         DEM_Votes_Raw = DEM_VOTES_NAME, 
         REP_Votes_Raw = REP_VOTES_NAME) %>% 
  mutate(
    DEM_Votes_Raw = parse_number(as.character(DEM_Votes_Raw)), 
    REP_Votes_Raw = parse_number(as.character(REP_Votes_Raw))
  ) %>%
  select(SR_Precinct_ID, DEM_Votes_Raw, REP_Votes_Raw)

CORRECT_ID_NAME <- "SRPREC" 
sr_precincts_sf <- st_read(SR_SHAPEFILE_PATH) %>%
  rename(SR_Precinct_ID = CORRECT_ID_NAME) %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 3310) %>%        
  st_set_precision(1) %>%             
  st_make_valid() %>%                 
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%    
  mutate(Original_Area = st_area(.)) %>%
  select(SR_Precinct_ID, Original_Area, geometry)

sr_precincts_votes_sf <- sr_precincts_sf %>%
  inner_join(vote_data, by = "SR_Precinct_ID")

weighted_votes_sf <- st_intersection(sr_precincts_votes_sf, ab604_districts_sf) %>%
  mutate(
    Overlap_Area = st_area(.),
    Area_Weight = as.numeric(Overlap_Area / Original_Area),
    Allocated_DEM_Votes = DEM_Votes_Raw * Area_Weight,
    Allocated_REP_Votes = REP_Votes_Raw * Area_Weight
  ) %>%
  select(New_District_ID, Allocated_DEM_Votes, Allocated_REP_Votes)

final_results_sf <- weighted_votes_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(New_District_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Allocated_DEM_Votes = sum(Allocated_DEM_Votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Allocated_REP_Votes = sum(Allocated_REP_Votes, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Votes = Total_Allocated_DEM_Votes + Total_Allocated_REP_Votes,
    DEM_Vote_Share = Total_Allocated_DEM_Votes / Total_Votes
  )
final_results_sf
```
